chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad who said, 'It was narrated to me from Khalid ibn Yazid from Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:'

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created a group from His creation, choosing them for fulfilling the needs of the poor of our Shia, so that He may reward them with Paradise for that. Therefore, if you are able to be among them, then be so.
Then he said to us, 'By Allah, there is a Lord whom we worship, and we do not associate anything with Him.'

key_terms.لِيُثِيبَهُمْ: so that He may reward them

ai.seo_question: Who are the chosen ones that fulfill the needs of the Shia poor according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the spiritual merit of fulfilling the needs of the poor among the Shia, framing it as a divinely selected role that guarantees Paradise. This hadith underscores the communal responsibility of the faithful to support one another, reinforcing the concept of *Tawhid* not just as theological belief but as active social service. The emphasis on 'our Shia' reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of viewing the community as a cohesive body bound by mutual care and divine election.
